home.title: Every mandala exists only once
home.intro: Engraved in wood, painted by hand, signed. Once a piece finds a home, it is never made again.

catalog.title: Works
catalog.intro: In Sanskrit, mandala means circle. For centuries it has been a form for meditation: a centre, surrounded by symmetries that repeat until they fill the space. Ours are engraved and hand-painted on wood, and each one exists only once. Sold pieces stay here as an archive.
